_note: Two Baidu photos of the airport from the air and its arrivals hall, alongside an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

lim-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，利马豪尔赫·查韦斯国际机场（LIM）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
lim-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

lim-baidu-1.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰利马机场：长条形的航站楼横在荒漠中，远处是太平洋，右侧是施工中的大片土方。
lim-baidu-1.webp.en: An aerial view of Lima's airport, its long terminal laid across desert ground with the Pacific beyond and earthworks under way on the right.

lim-baidu-2.webp.zh: 到达大厅里，旅客在柜台前排队等候，左侧天花板下悬着一件金属雕塑。
lim-baidu-2.webp.en: Passengers queue at the counters in the arrivals hall, with a metal sculpture suspended from the ceiling to the left.
